planning_notes: No serial I/O requirements were provided; serial_channels is empty.
For the tone_output gate behavior, SysML will drive tone frequency on the single tone channel on D6 continuously while D3 is pressed, and set tone output to initial=0 (silence) when not pressed.
Active-high semantics are used for the button model: the digital_input model value is true when the physical button is pressed; no additional inversion is applied.
Control period is chosen as 5 ms as a scheduling granularity; the actual 'continuous' duration is modeled using elapsed_ms in the SysML model rather than device-level timing.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button pressed command input (button model true when pressed)

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer continuous tone output while button is pressed
